description.fun: Meditite never skips its daily yoga, building up spiritual power through meditation until it can float in the air. Its training never ends, though, because it keeps losing focus mid-meditation. It eats just one berry a day as part of its discipline. In Generation 3, before gender differences existed, every Meditite looked female.
description.guide: A Fighting- and Psychic-type Pokémon based on a yoga practitioner, usually shown sitting in the lotus position. It trains for hours a day and can levitate through meditation. It evolves into Medicham at level 37.
description.tagline: A yoga student that meditates until it floats

description.fun: Medicham has honed a sixth sense through meditation and fasting, eating only once a month, and its psychic power lets it blend into its surroundings to hide. It fights with elegant, dance-like moves, dodging attacks before landing a crushing blow. Its puffy trousers and headpiece may draw on belly dancers' costumes as well as yoga.
description.guide: A Fighting- and Psychic-type Pokémon based on a yoga practitioner, which has developed a sixth sense through meditation. It evolves from Meditite at level 37 and can Mega Evolve with the Medichamite.
description.tagline: A yoga master that eats monthly and fights like a dancer

description.fun: Mega Evolution gives Medicham limitless mental power, which it uses to form four ghostly extra arms around itself; the more trained its spirit, the more real and dexterous those arms become. Its headpiece turns into a white turban set with a yellow stone, and gold bands appear around its wrists and waist.
